text_block_list.text:
"As an Umamusume currently in the spotlight,
Neo Universe was to be the subject of an in-depth documentary feature."

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Today, we'll be doing an in-depth interview to capture all of Neo Universe-san's charm!
We look forward to working with you!
choice_data_list: Likewise, I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative.
I will transmit a clear "signal" as much as possible.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: First up is running! We're covering quite the distance, though...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
""SMLA"—
In order to increase the sensitivity of "communication"."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: It's essential to bridge even more of the 'divide.'

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Neo Universe-san!
Please tell us about your lunch preferences!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sphira. I "like" things that have
"evolved" through "invisible decomposition."

The reporter enthusiastically continued to ask questions,
but he still seemed to be struggling
to understand what she meant...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... It's all because my understanding fell short...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: I feel pathetic for not being able to fully interpret Neo Universe's attitude and enthusiasm toward running—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"H-Huh!? Neo Universe!?
...Did she give up on me...?"
choice_data_list: ...I don't think that's necessarily the case, though.

text_block_list.text:
A few minutes later, Neo Universe returned,
having changed into her racing silks.
choice_data_list: What's up all of a sudden?
What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...『Keep your eyes on』 Neo Universe.
(WHOOSH!!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
That run just now... it was so powerful, so vivid...
Could it be... that just now was...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Just by watching someone run, everything can be communicated and understood...?
Is that what you mean?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. That's fine for now.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"...First contact.
First comes 'recognition' and 'understanding.'
The results are... 'fair enough.'"
choice_data_list: Did you actually still have more you wanted to talk about?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. The "propagation of will"
packed into this "racing outfit" starts now.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...The silhouette of this 'Racewear'
is modeled after an astronaut's suit.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A "material" that is also used in space development.
Much like unknown frontiers, it can withstand grueling "races."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Solitude, silence—space has 'no destination.'
Yet astronauts take flight because
they yearn to know the 'unknown.'

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Traveling in search of "contact,"
Neo Universe wants to "transmit" it.

Her phrasing was eccentric, but... it was clear
that she truly poured a heartfelt wish into her Racewear.
choice_data_list: If we interact, it'll come across!
Let's figure out how to do it.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Sfira!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"The 'unknown' becomes 'known' through connection.
...That way, our 'hearts' will surely reach each other."

"I nod along with Neo Universe's words.
I resolved to continue watching over her
journey into the unknown."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative.
I will certainly conduct "trial and error."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
It's a tough challenge, but...
that makes it "worth doing."

It might be a daunting challenge for her right now.
Even so, as long as she possessed a clear desire,
I felt certain that she would achieve it one day.
